description: This is a Java test class for MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidator, testing its behaviors such as immutability, validation of null inputs, and handling of CharSequence inputs for timeout headers.

classes.name: MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidator class, verifying validation logic and immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null header definition throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as the value throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateLong
methods.description: Checks that the validator can validate Java long types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures no exception is thrown for valid timeout string input.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotLong
methods.description: Checks that non-long header definitions are not validated.

methods.name: acceptNonLongCharSequence
methods.description: Tests that invalid timeout strings throw the appropriate exception.
